test_transcribe_audio: test the transcribe_audio function dispatches to groq, openai, local, or mistral providers based on config
test_get_provider: test the _get_provider function selects the correct STT provider from config, env keys, and auto-detect fallback priority
test_transcribe_groq: test the _transcribe_groq function transcribes audio via Groq API with model auto-correction and error handling
test_transcribe_openai: test the _transcribe_openai function transcribes audio via OpenAI API with base URL configuration and error handling
test_transcribe_local: test the _transcribe_local function transcribes audio locally using faster-whisper with model caching and reuse
test_transcribe_local_command: test the _transcribe_local_command function transcribes audio via a configurable local CLI whisper command
test_transcribe_mistral: test the _transcribe_mistral function transcribes audio via Mistral API with context manager and error handling
test_validate_audio_file: test the _validate_audio_file function validates audio file existence, format support, and case-insensitive extensions
test_load_stt_config: test the _load_stt_config function loads STT configuration from hermes_cli with dict fallback on import error
test_model_auto_correction: test model auto-correction overrides incompatible OpenAI model names when used with Groq API and vice versa
